title: How George Foreman Turned a Kitchen Appliance Into $138M
text:
In 1994, George Foreman passed on flat endorsement cash for a 45% profit share on a kitchen grill. Decades later, that uncapped equity deal generated over $200 million and a massive cash buyout. The lesson: trading time for capped checks limits your upside, but equity compounds.
